description.en:
Returns a random integer from 0 to max - 1. With max = 0 it returns 0.
The Special Move scripts (waza/) use it to pick one of their presentation variants.

The result can be forced once from outside. CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT takes a ninth argument that it stores as "SP_NUMBER" (-1 by default). The ev_main wrapper RunSkillScript passes its _cmrCut argument there. When CMND_RANDOM finds that value set, from 0 to max - 1, it returns it instead of a random number and resets it to -1. So the story events choose which variant of a Special Move plays, while normal play leaves it random.
Number of possible results (upper bound, excluded).

A value from 0 to max - 1 (the forced SP_NUMBER if one is set and in range).
0 when max is 0.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
